, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy named Tom lived with his mom and dad. They were a happy family.
One day, Tom saw a broken toy near the mountain. He wanted to help fix it. So, he went to his dad and said, "Dad, can we fix this toy?" His dad smiled and said, "Yes, Tom. Let's fix it together."
They worked hard to fix the toy house. But then, something unexpected happened. A big wind came and blew the broken toy house away. Tom and his dad were sad. They looked around the town and found the toy house on a small hill. The broken toy house was not broken anymore. It was just like the mountain. Tom and his family were so happy, and they lived happily ever after.
